newsitem.title: USA: Homestake sees 97 gold output at 1.9 mln oz.
newsitem.headline: Homestake sees 97 gold output at 1.9 mln oz.

text.p: Homestake Mining Co said Monday construction began last week on the West Archimedes orebody on the company's Ruby Hill property in central Nevada, near the town of Eureka.
With gold production scheduled to commence in the fourth quarter of this year, the company said it sees gold production this year of 1.9 million ounces.
Upon completion of construction, Homestake said, it will process some 3,500 tons of ore per day at Ruby Hill to produce between 105,000 and 110,000 ounces of gold on an annual basis.
At current estimates, Ruby Hill will become the company's lowest cost gold mine with projected total cash costs of about $140 per ounce and total production costs of $258 per ounce.
It said the estimated cost of the project is $65.4 million, including $20.9 million for mining equipment and prestripping. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
